Mira: Heads up — Azure EDP negotiation next Tue. Primary topics: reserved GPU floor, cross-region failover rights, and billing transparency. We should sync internal asks today.
Raj: +1. Main operational ask: carveout for a dedicated reserved pool in us-west-2 with a guaranteed failover lane in us-east-1. We can’t accept silent bursting into preemptible class.
Kyle: From finance: we have flexibility on commit size if discounts + credit protections are meaningful. Ballpark: $1.2M ARR commit -> expecting ~35-45% off sustained GPU SKUs. Need concrete metering and invoice line items to model ROI.
Sam: Ops note — our traffic tail is spiky. We need an explicit burst buffer (not preemptible) or a defined credit allowance when provider routes us to lower-priority instances. Otherwise latency SLOs break.
Olga (Azure rep): Thanks — we can take those to SR. Two quick Qs: (1) Do you want hard regional capacity guarantees or soft SLO + credits? (2) Any minimum burst size requirement (vGPU count / hours)?
Mira: Prefer hard guarantees for the reserved pool up to X vGPUs, and a documented failover plan for region-to-region. If they can't promise, we want credits that scale with unmet capacity. Burst size: 200 vGPUs for 3 hours should cover peak traffic.
Raj: Also ask for telemetry hooks on capacity events (API/webhook) — when capacity is degraded, we need an event to trigger routing to other regions or reduce batch sizes.
Kyle: Example billing ask: line-level SKU breakdown per day + applied reserved coverage per SKU per day. Without that, we can't verify credits.
billing-bot: Invoice snippet for Feb 2026 (auto-post):
```
DATE,SKU,USAGE_MIN,RESERVED_COVERAGE_MIN,OVERRUN_MIN,CHARGE
2026-02-14,GPU-A100,2450000,1800000,650000,$312,500
2026-02-14,GPU-A10G,120000,120000,0,$9,600
```
Raj: That overrun is the problem — large opaque overrun with no per-request tagging. We need the provider to enable metering by reservation-id so we can trace which workload caused overrun.
Olga (Azure rep): We can propose adding reservation-id tagging to usage reports; will confirm with product. Credits for unmet capacity typically require a measurable metric — e.g., % of requests routed to preemptible vs committed capacity. Is that acceptable?
Sam: Yes. We can accept credit formula: credit = min(1, unmet_committed_minutes / committed_minutes) * monthly_commit_value * alpha. Need alpha to be >0.5 to be meaningful.
Kyle: Finance wants the exact credit formula in the contract. If alpha < 0.5 we won't sign. Also require a quarterly reconciliation window with invoice-level adjustments.
Mira: Add a clause: provider must give 72hr notice before mass preemption or region maintenance that could affect our reserved pool; otherwise immediate credits apply.
Olga (Azure rep): Noted — operational notice windows are negotiable. One followup: for failover bandwidth (eg cross-region egress), do you want provider to cover some egress costs when they trigger failover?
Mira: Yes, we should request partial egress credits for provider-initiated failovers. Have legal draft a fallback list: provider-covered egress for first 48 hours of emergency failover.
Raj: Also suggest we ask for a commitment to provide spare capacity telemetry (trend forecasts) 7 days out for the regions in scope. That helps our autoscale policies.
Kyle: I'll model two scenarios overnight: (A) 40% discount + alpha=0.6 credits + 200 vGPU burst pool; (B) 30% discount + stronger failover egress credits + extended notice. Will share numbers by EOD.
Olga (Azure rep): I'll push these asks and get back with their default contract language and any exceptions. Expect initial feedback in 48-72h.
Mira: Great — prep items for internal call at 3pm: (1) final commit band we can offer, (2) legal must-have clauses (credits formula, notice windows, metering), (3) technical telemetry hooks.
Sam: I’ll draft telemetry webhook spec and reservation-id tagging example.
billing-bot: New reconciliation report ready: https://redwood-internal/recon/edp/202602-recon (contains per-SKU, per-reservation CSV).
Mira: Perfect — thanks. If we get the reservation-id tagging and a clear credit formula, we can push this into an LOI within the week. :thumbsup:
Kyle: FYI — will include sensitivity table: commit size vs implied unit price and break-even hours.
Olga (Azure rep): Thanks everyone — I’ll follow up with a timeline after internal alignment.
Mira: End of thread — will post the negotiation prep doc to #vendors shortly.
